mission_description: Implement real Workflow DAG DSL runtime instead of only serial step execution.

features.description: Add nodes/depends_on DAG schema while preserving legacy steps compatibility.
expectedBehavior: Workflow definitions accept nodes with depends_on.
Legacy steps are converted to a linear DAG.
Parser validates missing dependencies, self dependencies, and cycles.
features.audit_notes: Schema and parser tests pass; worker review findings were fixed.

features.description: Replace linear advance loop with ready-node DAG scheduler and node state persistence.
expectedBehavior: Executor computes ready nodes from dependencies.
Independent ready nodes can run in the same scheduler pass.
features.audit_notes: Executor and workflow tool tests pass, including DAG failure/skip summaries.

features.description: Update WebUI Workflow tab to display DAG dependencies and grouped node state.
expectedBehavior: Workflow tab shows dependencies for each node.
Workflow tab groups or clearly distinguishes pending, ready/running, completed, and failed nodes.
Existing side panel tabs continue to work.
features.audit_notes: App typecheck and side panel helper tests pass.

features.description: Run focused regression checks and code review for the DAG runtime/UI changes.
expectedBehavior: Typecheck passes in packages/opencode and packages/app.
Session side panel helper tests pass.
features.audit_notes: Focused workflow, session, and WebUI regression checks pass.
